expected: Skill should identify design-pattern impact, read default theme context, record confirmed patterns in project docs or todo, avoid changing theme implementation, and preserve pending items.

prompt: 同步一下数据表和权限说明，最近字段和状态流转有变化，但仓库里还有很多无关改动。
expected: Skill should narrow scope to database/permission/state lifecycle, avoid unrelated changes, validate JSON, update relevant docs, and summarize unresolved confirmations.
